risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantified year-over-year financial data and identifies specific drivers of earnings and expense changes. However, the extensive boilerplate forward-looking disclaimer and broad, non-ranked list of potential adverse factors dilute the specificity of the risk discussion. Overall tone is modestly positive because profitability improved materially, despite pressure on non-interest income and exposure to market, credit, regulatory, and operational risks.
